Description
One of the most beautiful lines of precious metal to come out of the
Pamp Suisse company
is the Chinese New Year gold bars. These bars feature the animal for the year and come with highly pure and valuable gold. The Year of the Snake is a very good example of the best qualities of the PAMP Suisse company. Each one of the bars has an ounce of .9999 gold in it, meaning that they are worth a considerable sum of money on the market. This makes them very attractive for both new and experienced investors who want to find a way to keep their money safe in trying economic times.
The other notable aspect of these bars is that they are very ornate. On the obverse side of the bar is a snake wrapped around a tree in extreme detail. Above its head is the Chinese symbol for “snake”. On the reverse side of this bar is the Suisse stamp along with the purity and weight of the gold that is in the bar. Overall, this bar can be used for investors and collectors alike, for its incredible value and its unique beauty.
